title: South Florida Halloween Weekend Plans
igCaption:
Halloween weekend has gardens, metal, arena pop and a Sunday night throwback.
Oct 23 to 25, Miami and Fort Lauderdale, free to $238

Sources: Miami New Times, Secret Miami

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #HalloweenWeekend #FortLauderdale

scenes.text: Halloween weekend in South Florida starts with ghost lore in Miami Beach and keeps moving from there.

Friday starts at Miami Beach Botanical Garden with Folklore and Foliage. It runs at 6 p.m. on Convention Center Drive, with old Florida ghost lore from author Thomas Smith, shadow puppets, tarot readings, and free admission with RSVP.
scenes.caption: Friday starts at Miami Beach Botanical Garden with Folklore & Foliage. It runs at 6 p.m. on Convention Center Drive, with Old Florida ghost lore from author Thomas Smith, shadow puppets, tarot readings, and free admission with RSVP.

scenes.text: Saturday is at Revolution Live in Fort Lauderdale. Scene Queen brings the Metalicious Tour at 7 p.m., with Wargasm and Bailey Spinn opening. Tickets cost $39.50 through Ticketmaster.
scenes.caption: Saturday is at Revolution Live in Fort Lauderdale. Scene Queen brings the Metalicious Tour at 7 p.m., with Wargasm and Bailey Spinn opening. Tickets cost $39.50 through Ticketmaster.

scenes.text: Also Saturday, Sombr plays Amerant Bank Arena in Sunrise on the You Are The Reasons Tour. The Last Dinner Party and The Hellp open. Tickets run from $51 to $238 on SeatGeek. If you’re at Amerant, open NEAR and see who else showed.

scenes.text: Sunday ends at ZeyZey Miami. Peter Bjorn and John celebrate 20 years of Writer’s Block at 7 p.m. on NE 61st Street. Tickets cost $35 through ZeyZey Miami.
